youtube.baslik: Can a normal-looking infant tympanogram hide middle ear fluid? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In infants under six months, a 226 Hz tympanogram can look peaked and normal even with middle ear fluid. The main reason is the soft newborn ear canal wall; a 1000 Hz probe tone is used in this age group.
